verificationPolicy.integrity: Pinned SHA-256 hashes, complete tool inventories, source-state checks, locked dependency verification and compiler notice recollection are internal safeguards supporting release review.
verificationPolicy.reproducibility: Byte-identical rebuilds are not a release requirement. Exact plugin/toolchain build records can improve provenance but must not be represented as standalone MIT obligations.
verificationPolicy.approval: These distinctions do not approve public redistribution or waive applicable corresponding-source and notice obligations.
